render.tilesManifestPrelude: # mpf2 (VMID 220) — MAME mpf2 (Multitech Microprofessor II, 1982) -> Applesoft BASIC. ssh 5820. Keyboard-only.
render.tilesManifestInvocation:
emit mpf2 \
  --tile mpf2 --vmid 220 --udp 54124 --pointer none --input-backend disabled \
  --cursor-scale 1.0 --cursor-off-x 0 --cursor-off-y 0 --audio on --fps 60 \
  --launcher-file "$T/mpf2/qemu-streamhost.sh" \
  --env-append-file "$T/mpf2/tile.env.fixture"
render.bindingLine: mpf2:        { osId: 'mpf2',        archetypeId: 'beige-tower-crt', transport: 'streamhost',  accentColor: '#8B4513', eraLabel: '1982 · MPF-II BASIC' },

tileEnv.SH_FIXTURE_DESC: Multitech Microprofessor II Applesoft BASIC 560x192 @ 60 Hz composite (6-colour artifact) drawn fullscreen with aspect correction on a 1024x768 X root in MAME mpf2; golden snapshot restores X (-nocursor) + MAME at the BASIC prompt and a MAME soft reset re-runs the ROM power-on beep; keyboard-only exhibit; no pointer device. Keyboard quirks: SH_KEY_REMAP delivers Backspace as Left (the machine's matrix has no Backspace; Left is its rubout key), SH_KEY_MIN_HOLD_MS=32 holds every key for 2 emulated frames, and SH_KEY_MIN_GAP_MS=32 keeps 2 frames of gap between one key's release and the next key's press — measured on the live tile, a release-to-press gap under ~8 ms makes the machine read two keystrokes as one held chord (browser typing leaves ~2 ms).

museum.blurb: Taiwan's first mass-market home computer — a chiclet-keyboard Apple II clone that boots straight to BASIC, in 6 colours on a television set.
museum.notes: Live streamhost tile. Emulator-in-captured-Linux BRIDGE tile: a captured Debian 12 kiosk runs MAME (mpf2 driver) emulating a Multitech MPF-II that boots its ROM BASIC; streamhost captures the Linux framebuffer + AC97 audio exactly like every other tile. Keyboard-only exhibit (no pointing device — the real machine had none); uses the beige-tower-crt fallback until a bespoke MPF-II archetype exists. See streamhost/docs/BRIDGE.md and docs/guests/mpf2.md.

reset.fixture: Multitech Microprofessor II 560x192 @ 60 Hz composite (6-colour artifact) drawn fullscreen with aspect correction on a 1024x768 X root in MAME mpf2; golden INTERNAL snapshot restores X (-nocursor) + MAME showing the MPF-II banner and BASIC prompt exactly as baked from a cold boot. No post-restore keys: driving a MAME soft reset to replay the ROM power-on beep raced the restore and intermittently left the screen scrolled with the banner gone and two prompts stacked. Keyboard-only exhibit (no mouse); AC97 audio.
